mapper.select:
SELECT FROM ( SELECT opportunity.stage, COALESCE(stage.stage_name, opportunity.stage) AS stage_name, opportunity.owner_id AS owner, opportunity.owner_name, opportunity.dept_id AS department, opportunity.dept_name AS department_name, opportunity.opportunity_id AS opportunity_count, opportunity.expected_amount, opportunity.weighted_amount, (opportunity.expected_amount IS NULL OR opportunity.win_rate IS NULL OR opportunity.weighted_amount IS NULL OR opportunity.win_rate < 0 OR opportunity.win_rate > 100 OR opportunity.weighted_amount <> ROUND(opportunity.expected_amount * opportunity.win_rate / 100, 2)) AS integrity_error FROM crm_opportunity opportunity INNER JOIN crm_customer customer ON customer.customer_id = opportunity.customer_id AND customer.tenant_id = opportunity.tenant_id AND customer.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN crm_sales_stage stage ON stage.tenant_id = opportunity.tenant_id AND stage.stage_code = opportunity.stage AND stage.deleted = 0 WHERE opportunity.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND opportunity.deleted = 0
) fact
